comments.author: @leechumbley5440
comments.text: My theory is that the warrah (a pair or a pregnant female) came on a piece of flotsam driven by the fierce-som 50s from Patagonia (would have to find evidence of a similar canine in Patagonia to support this theory). A millenium later, trusting, like the dodo and the moa, it was exterminated. Man, the most dangerous animal. A British military ship circled the Falkland Islands for ages. Someone (stay close to your desk, and never go to sea, and you may be the leader of the Queen's navy) in London thought it was silly and throwing money away. The ship was ordered to leave the Falklands. When the ship was hardly out of sight en route to Great Britain, General Gualtieri of Argentina (he of  Junta Dirty War, torture and disappearances infamy) ordered the invasion, costing Britain  far more for the Falkland War than the ship ever did.  Gualtieri had been watching the whole time, waiting for Britain to let its guard down.
